responsibility: This file is the main implementation of gfortran command-line option processing after GCC’s generic decoding. It initializes Fortran option state, determines source form from filenames, applies language-standard defaults, handles DEC compatibility bundles, include/module paths, initialization flags, FPE and runtime-check options, standard-selection effects, preprocessing integration, and compiler_options() string reconstruction, while coordinating with generated option handlers and cpp setup.
